text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru now faces the Kinko Sho, where Silence Suzuka will be competing as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Puffed up with pride, Matikanefukukitaru declares how much she's changed compared to last year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka is concerned by her strange mannerisms and how she seems to believe that her luck is infallible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a strange glint in her eye, she heads to the track.
